items.pf-esi: Per employee, the PF and ESI the closed runs actually deducted; the rates come from a signed pack, and when the only pack is synthetic the screen refuses figures and says why.
items.pf-esi-register: Whether PF and ESI apply to each employee, the UAN / ESI number and from when.
items.tds: TDS deducted per employee from the closed runs; declarations and quarterly returns are their own registers.
items.tds-declarations: The employee's investment declaration per financial year: PAN, regime, 80C / 80D, exemptions.
items.tds-returns: Quarterly 24Q tracker per company: deducted, deposited, due, filed and the acknowledgement.
items.pt: Professional tax slabs by state and wage band.
items.gratuity: Accrued liability per employee: last drawn basic × 15/26 × completed years from 5 years' service, capped — every rule in config/gratuity.json, working on every row.
items.bonus: Payment of Bonus Act working per employee from the closed runs: eligible months, wage counted up to the ceiling, bonus at both ends of the band — config/statutory-bonus.json.
items.bonus-register: Form C: the bonus declared and paid per employee per financial year.
items.min-wages: Notified minimum wage by state / zone / category, effective-dated.
items.compliance-alerts: PF ECR, ESI, PT and TDS due dates per period from config/compliance-calendar.json — overdue, due, upcoming or filed, with the filing recorded against the company.
items.posh: Confidential complaints to the Internal Committee; visible only to those who may read employee documents.
items.audit-reports: Every statutory register with its count and a CSV, scoped by Organization Setup.
items.statutory-config: Which rate packs are in force and where every statutory rule lives — read-only, nothing typed into a settings row.
